messages:
maya: Heads up — ARB slot this Thu 11:00am PT. Need a facilitator for the week of Mar 25. Also drafting agenda. Volunteers?
dave: I can facilitator that week. Quick question — do we want a pre-read for the kv-cache RFC?
maya: thanks! @dave in the slot. Yes, please. I can post the RFC link tomorrow. Pre-read should be 10–15 mins.
anh: I can prep the dynamic-batching design notes and add diagrams. what's preferred slide format? PDF or Google Slides?
maya: GSlides preferred. Put link in the thread by EOD Wed. Also need someone to run triage for outstanding infra items.
priya: I can run triage. I'll pull top 5 blockers and add short notes.
sam: can we add "quantization impact on perf" as a 5-min lightning item? pinging @eli for data.
eli: yup, I'll bring perf numbers. may need an extra 10 mins if there are follow-ups.
maya: proposed agenda (keep it tight):
``` 
1) RFC review: kv-cache-proposal (15m) — presenter: @dave
2) Design review: dynamic-batching (20m) — presenter: @anh
3) Lightning: quantization perf (5m) — @eli
4) Triage: infra backlog (10m) — lead: @priya
5) AOB / rollouts (5m)
```
notes: aim for 55m total.
agenda-bot: New ARB meeting created: Thu Mar 25 11:00am PT — link: https://meet.redwood.ai/arb/03-25
dave: I'll add short bullets to the RFC doc with what I'd like reviewers to focus on (latency regressions, fallback behavior).
anh: putting slides in GDrive — https://drive.google.com/anh-dynbatch (will mark as "for review")
priya: triage list done, will share thread tomorrow morning.
sam: adding quantization notes to perf doc. If we need more time, can defer to next week.
eli: quick note — if any database migration talks come up we should schedule a separate meeting.
maya: perfect. if anyone wants to swap facilitator, speak up by Tue noon. otherwise @dave is on deck. :thumbsup:
